name: Heeler
description: Native iPhone and iPad console for herdr: watch and drive coding agents on your machines over SSH, in Herdr TUI or the Herdr desktop app (herdr-core), with a real libghostty terminal, native Chat, QR pairing, and push notifications when an agent needs you

issues.title: Scheduled full iOS verification is failing
Agent Notifications only say "Done": add Host, Tab, task title and an optional result preview
Voice Input: On Device transcription with a live recorder (iOS 26)
Hardware keyboard: opening an Agent doesn't focus the input
PTY reads can miss a reset socket for 20 seconds in package E2E
Chat can't find Claude Code's input box when prompt suggestions are enabled
Keep the last screen visible while reconnecting after a foreground return
Per-pane name for sessions so the Agent list rows are distinguishable

### Added

- Open an image you sent to Claude Code or Codex by tapping its `[Image #N]` in your message, or with Preview Image in the message's menu, when it was pasted from a file, as Heeler's attached images are. (PR #674)
- Read Heeler in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan). On a Traditional Chinese device, or with Traditional Chinese chosen as Heeler's language, everything Japanese and Simplified Chinese cover presents in Traditional Chinese, permission prompts included. (PR #668)
- Read Heeler in Simplified Chinese. On a Simplified Chinese device, or with Simplified Chinese chosen as Heeler's language, everything Japanese covers presents in Chinese, permission prompts included. (PR #662)
- Find Heeler's language in Settings > Language, which names the language Heeler shows and opens Heeler's page in iOS Settings, where iOS keeps each app's language. (PR #662)
- Switch Claude Code's model and effort through Chat's title menu, under Model, with the current model on its second line beside a folder icon and the launch directory's last component. Permission mode stays beside the Composer. The native menu opens locally with fixed Opus, Sonnet, Haiku and Fable shortcuts, without probing the session or adding `/model` to the conversation merely by opening it. The title remains tappable while busy or switching; choices are enabled only while the Agent is Idle or Done and no send or switch is underway. Selecting sends `/model <alias>`; Claude Code resolves any user-configured third-party mapping and saves the selection as it normally does. Heeler does not configure mappings or verify provider availability. Permission modes cycle with Shift+Tab, bypass asks first, and effort uses `/effort`. The label changes only once the terminal confirms. (PR #647)
- Filter the Agents list from its filter icon, with a height-limited, independently scrolling Host section above Agent Status and a double-down chevron while more Hosts remain below. Hosts support multiple selections across Agents and Terminals; All Hosts clears only the Host selection. All Status clears only the status selection; Blocked, Working, Done and Idle show counts and allow multiple selections. The status filter is kept across launches, and a list it empties offers Show All. (PR #647)
- Pick up to 10 images at once in the Composer, staged one after another. The note that an image path was inserted and copied goes by itself after 2 seconds. (PR #647)
- Read Heeler in Japanese. On a Japanese device, or with Japanese chosen in the app's per-app language setting, the Console's tabs and lists, Chat, Changes, Usage, Settings, alerts, permission prompts, widgets, notifications and Live Activity labels
